label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Primary retroperitoneal soft-tissue sarcoma is broad anatomical scope, but the unexplained exclusion 'Other types of sarcomas' prevents confidently assigning EMC compatibility from the saved text. The extraskeletal chondrosarcoma keyword alone is insufficient.
cohort_reconciliation: IMPT and IMRT arms share preoperative primary retroperitoneal sarcoma eligibility and exclude multifocal/nodal/distant disease. No separately specified EMC cohort resolves the ambiguous histology exclusion.
extra_biomarker_requirement: Optional circulating/genomic DNA samples; no required tumor molecular alteration stated.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol needed to define 'Other types of sarcomas' and confirm EMC histology scope. Brief summary calls phase I while title/design describe I/II; both retained.
quotes: Histologically proven primary soft tissue sarcoma of the retroperitoneum

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: Nononcology Crohn's study expressly excludes non-GI cancer history apart from specified epithelial exceptions; EMC is not one of those exceptions.
cohort_reconciliation: Afimkibart induction and placebo induction followed by afimkibart share Crohn's criteria; no oncology cohort.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed; prohibited medicines and contraception details not fully saved. This is disease-scope exclusion, not a patient judgment.
quotes: History of non-gastrointestinal cancer, with the exception of adequately treated non-metastatic basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer or in situ cervical cancer

label: broad_tumor_compatible
rationale: Phase I admits histologically diagnosed sarcoma and phase II has an other-sarcoma cohort. EMC can fit this broad histology scope; the Ewing-specific FET-ETS criterion does not make EMC an Ewing case.
cohort_reconciliation: All six phase I dose levels share general sarcoma eligibility.
Phase II Ewing requires Ewing histology plus FET-ETS fusion; NR4A3 fusion alone does not meet that route. DSRCT requires DSRCT histology plus EWSR1::WT1.

Other-sarcoma phase II requires sarcoma with evaluable/measurable disease. Dedicated RMS/osteosarcoma/other round-cell slots do not expressly close the broader cohort; actual slot allocation remains unverified.
Prior progression on irinotecan/temozolomide and CNS exclusion apply specifically to Ewing/DSRCT phase II, not automatically to the other-sarcoma cohort.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional molecular alteration stated for phase I or other-sarcoma entry; named Ewing/DSRCT fusions apply only to their restricted cohorts.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol, phase transitions and actual availability of non-dedicated slots unverified. Age 12-49, weight at least 40 kg, prior therapy, organ criteria and temozolomide payment/insurance requirements remain consequential.
quotes: Slots in this cohort will include three dedicated slots
Molecular evidence of a FET-ETS family translocation

label: insufficient_evidence
rationale: Ulcerative colitis treatment study supplies no EMC cancer-scope evidence or explicit cancer exclusion in the saved criteria.
cohort_reconciliation: JNJ-78934804 and guselkumab arms, rescue treatment and long-term extension all remain within ulcerative colitis scope.
protocol_uncertainty: Cancer-comorbidity applicability is unestablished; external protocol unreviewed. Rescue and extension require protocol criteria/investigator benefit assessment.
quotes: Diagnosis of ulcerative colitis (UC) established at least 12 weeks before screening

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: The broad soft-tissue sarcoma wording is overridden by an express exclusion naming extraosseous myxoid chondrosarcoma.
cohort_reconciliation: Both MASCT-I plus doxorubicin/ifosfamide and doxorubicin/ifosfamide control share the exclusion; no rescue basket for EMC.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No biomarker can override the named disease exclusion; cell products do not establish a molecular entry route.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol unreviewed. Registry's rationale that named histologies are unsuitable for AI is protocol language, not an independently established clinical claim here.
quotes: which are not suitable for Doxorubicin+ Ifosfamide (AI) treatment.
